name: zeffect_anim_ensure_copied_root_tree
description: zEffectAnim::EnsureCopiedRootTree optionally clones the source root, rebinds the entry to the clone, clears the copy-needed flag, and reports success.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded for this helper; tier S verification is deferred to a coherent zEffectAnim source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x45e6d0 validates the null-self return, testing the copied-root flag, calling zClass_cls_util::CopyNode with the recovered global copy arguments, rebinding the entry to the copied root, clearing the flag, and returning one on success.
The native smoke verifies null-self failure, no-copy success without changing the bound node, and copy-flag success that rebinds names and clears the flag.
